title: SparsePO: Controlling Preference Alignment of LLMs via Sparse Token Masks
authors_zh: Fenia Christopoulou, Ronald Cardenas, Gerasimos Lampouras, Haitham Bou-Ammar, Jun Wang
paper_type_zh: 稀疏 token 级偏好优化研究
best_for_zh: 研究 token 级奖励和正则化选择如何重塑偏好训练信号、又不收集新标注的读者。
one_line: SparsePO learns sparse token masks that independently weight reward and KL contributions inside preference optimization.
SparsePO 学习稀疏 token 掩码，在偏好优化中分别加权奖励项和 KL 项的贡献。
why: It makes each token's reward and KL contribution an explicit learnable part of the training record rather than an implicit consequence of a response-level loss.
inclusion_reason: It changes the per-token reward and regularization signals consumed by preference optimization, instead of accepting a whole response pair as uniformly weighted supervision.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Response-level preference objectives normally apply reward pressure and KL regularization across all tokens in both completions. Yet many preferences are determined by a few words or phrases, such as a toxic expression, a sentiment-bearing word, or a factual statement. Uniform weighting can therefore force harmless context tokens to remain near the reference model and can blur the small positions that actually explain why one response is preferred.

The paper asks how preference optimization can decide, during training, which tokens should carry reward pressure and which should be held close to the reference. Its answer is to introduce masks directly into both token-level reward and KL terms. The masks may be supplied by reference-model activations or learned jointly with the policy, allowing the training objective to discover a sparse distribution of supervision instead of assuming all text is equally relevant.

回答级偏好目标通常会在两个完成文本的所有 token 上施加奖励压力和 KL 正则化。然而，许多偏好由少数词或短语决定，例如有毒表达、携带情感的词或事实陈述。统一加权因而可能迫使无害的上下文 token 贴近参考模型，并模糊真正解释为何一个回答更受偏好的少数位置。

论文要回答的是：偏好优化如何在训练过程中决定哪些 token 应承受奖励压力、哪些 token 应被保持在参考模型附近。它的回答是在 token 级奖励项和 KL 项中直接引入掩码。掩码可以由参考模型激活提供，也可以与策略共同学习，使训练目标发现稀疏的监督分布，而不是假设所有文本同等相关。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
SparsePO treats the contribution of a token as a learnable control variable. One mask weights the token's reward-related log-ratio, and another masks the token-level KL divergence from the reference policy. A small mask means that a token contributes little to the respective part of the loss, permitting the model to concentrate alignment pressure on positions that signal the target preference and to relax unnecessary reference anchoring elsewhere.

The method offers two ways to obtain these weights. A dense variant aggregates standardized activations from the reference model and uses one common mask. A sparse variant learns feed-forward mask heads from hidden representations; ReLU naturally creates many low-weight positions and the reward and KL masks can either be shared or independent. These masks exist only while training and are not required at inference, so the change lies in how existing preference records are consumed.

SparsePO 将一个 token 的贡献视为可学习的控制变量。一个掩码加权该 token 与奖励相关的对数比，另一个掩码加权它相对于参考策略的 token 级 KL 散度。较小的掩码意味着该 token 对相应损失部分贡献很少，使模型能够将对齐压力集中到指示目标偏好的位置，并在其他位置放松不必要的参考模型锚定。

该方法提供两种获得这些权重的方式。稠密变体聚合参考模型的标准化激活，并使用一个共同掩码。稀疏变体从隐藏表示中学习前馈掩码头；ReLU 自然产生许多低权重位置，奖励与 KL 掩码可以共享，也可以独立。这些掩码只在训练时存在，推理时不需要，因此改变的是既有偏好记录被消费的方式。

title: Method
方法
html:
SparsePO starts from a token-level preference formulation and inserts a mask value between epsilon and one for each token. The reward mask multiplies the policy/reference log ratio in the chosen and rejected responses; the KL mask multiplies next-token KL divergence. The resulting objective compares the masked reward totals while subtracting the difference between masked KL terms. The paper permits the two masks to be identical or to be learned separately, so reward emphasis and reference regularization need not follow the same positions.

For activation-based masks, the method standardizes and averages feed-forward, residual, and attention activations across layers of the reference model. For learnable masks, small ReLU networks read each layer's hidden states and a final projection combines them; ReLU induces sparse values automatically. The masks are trained alongside preference optimization and ignored after training. Experiments use synthetic sentiment preferences, Anthropic HH dialogue preferences, and Reddit TL;DR summary preferences, comparing dense, common sparse, and independent sparse configurations.

SparsePO 从一个 token 级偏好表述出发，为每个 token 插入一个介于 epsilon 和一之间的掩码值。奖励掩码乘以入选和拒绝回答中策略、参考模型的对数比；KL 掩码乘以下一个 token 的 KL 散度。得到的目标比较被掩码的奖励总和，并减去被掩码 KL 项之间的差异。论文允许两种掩码相同或分别学习，因此奖励强调和参考正则化不必遵循相同的位置。

对于基于激活的掩码，该方法对参考模型各层的前馈、残差和注意力激活进行标准化并取平均。对于可学习掩码，小型 ReLU 网络读取每层隐藏状态，最终投影将它们合并；ReLU 自动诱导稀疏值。掩码与偏好优化一起训练，并在训练后被忽略。实验使用合成情感偏好、Anthropic HH 对话偏好和 Reddit TL;DR 摘要偏好，并比较稠密、共同稀疏和独立稀疏配置。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On Anthropic HH single-turn dialogue, the common sparse-mask configuration wins against DPO at every reported temperature, with a 62.96 percent win rate at temperature zero versus 44.32 for TDPO v1. The authors report an average gain of 19.56 percentage points over that baseline. On Open LLM Leaderboard reasoning tasks with Pythia-1.4B, the dense configuration reaches a 40.80 average, above DPO at 39.65 and the listed SePO baseline at 36.56, while the common sparse configuration reaches 40.69.

For TL;DR summarization, SparsePO variants also beat DPO responses in the pairwise study; the independent-mask variant reaches 55.20 percent at temperature zero, while the dense variant is preferred at the other reported temperatures. The discussion reports an average 17.2 percentage-point gain over TDPO v1 in that comparison and finds comparable relevance, diversity, and faithfulness measurements for several configurations. The evidence is therefore multi-domain, but it also shows that the best mask choice is task dependent.

在 Anthropic HH 单轮对话上，共同稀疏掩码配置在所有报告温度下都胜过 DPO；温度为零时，胜率为 62.96%，而 TDPO v1 为 44.32%。作者报告它相对该基线平均提升 19.56 个百分点。在使用 Pythia-1.4B 的 Open LLM Leaderboard 推理任务上，稠密配置的平均分为 40.80，高于 DPO 的 39.65 和列出的 SePO 基线的 36.56，而共同稀疏配置达到 40.69。

对于 TL;DR 摘要，SparsePO 变体在成对研究中也胜过 DPO 回答；独立掩码变体在温度为零时达到 55.20%，而稠密变体在其他报告温度下更受偏好。讨论部分报告，在这一比较中它相对 TDPO v1 平均提升 17.2 个百分点，并发现若干配置的相关性、多样性和忠实性测量相当。因此证据覆盖多个领域，但也表明最佳掩码选择依赖于任务。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
SparsePO's main novelty is to make both sides of preference optimization selectively consumable. Earlier objectives may change the response-level reward, or selectively attend to tokens for one signal, but this work exposes separate per-token choices for reward and KL regularization. A token can be important for moving toward a preference without being equally important for staying close to the reference model, and the independent-mask formulation encodes that distinction directly in the loss.

It further avoids a separate external selector by deriving masks from the reference model or learning them on the fly. The sparse mask is not a preprocessing label attached once to a dataset; it evolves during optimization with the policy and target preference proxy. This makes the contribution a method for changing the optimization surface of fixed preference pairs, rather than a new preference-data collection or a generic inference-time diversity technique.

SparsePO 的主要新意是让偏好优化的两侧都可以被选择性消费。早期目标可能改变回答级奖励，或为某一种信号选择性地关注 token，而该工作为奖励和 KL 正则化分别暴露了逐 token 的选择。一个 token 对朝向某种偏好移动可能很重要，却不一定对贴近参考模型同样重要；独立掩码表述将这一区分直接编码进损失中。

它还避免使用独立的外部选择器，而是从参考模型导出掩码或在训练中即时学习掩码。稀疏掩码不是一次性附加到数据集的预处理标签；它会随策略和目标偏好代理在优化期间演化。因此，该贡献是改变固定偏好对优化表面的方法，而不是一个新的偏好数据集合或通用的推理时多样性技巧。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The authors caution that preference-optimization results are highly task dependent and may not transfer to particular human-preference proxies. The degree and location of learned sparsity interact with the beta setting and the chosen mask design, so adoption requires configuration work rather than a universal default. In the summary experiment, sparse masks can be suboptimal, and the paper reports no official code release or reusable learned masks, which limits direct reproducibility beyond the full methodological description.
作者警告，偏好优化结果高度依赖任务，可能无法迁移到特定的人类偏好代理。学习到的稀疏性程度和位置会与 beta 设置及所选掩码设计相互作用，因此采用该方法需要进行配置工作，而不是使用一个普适默认值。在摘要实验中，稀疏掩码可能不是最优，论文也没有报告官方代码发布或可复用的已学习掩码，这限制了超出完整方法描述之外的直接复现。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: This paper is useful when a team has fixed pairwise data but wants to control where reward pressure and reference regularization act. It offers a principled alternative to treating token selection as a single static filter: keep all records, but let the objective learn which positions matter for each term. Before using it, evaluate both common and independent masks on the actual preference property, inspect sparsity by response length and token type, and verify that the selected data and hyperparameters do not shift the objective toward an unintended proxy.
当团队拥有固定的成对数据，却希望控制奖励压力和参考正则化作用在何处时，这篇论文很有用。它提供了一种有原则的替代方案，不把 token 选择视为一次静态过滤：保留所有记录，但让目标学习每一项损失中哪些位置重要。在使用之前，应针对实际偏好属性评估共同和独立掩码，按回答长度和 token 类型检查稀疏性，并核验所选数据和超参数不会将目标推向非预期的代理指标。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read Equations 6–8 together with Section 2.3: the crucial distinction is between the reward mask and the KL mask, not merely between dense and sparse training. Then compare Tables 1–3 because they show different configurations leading on dialogue, reasoning, and summarization. A rigorous reproduction should log mask sharing, initialization, beta, mask-weight regularization, reference activations or mask-head architecture, and the mask distribution after training; without those records, a claim of "sparse preference optimization" is too underspecified to compare.
应将公式 6 至 8 与第 2.3 节一起阅读：关键区分在于奖励掩码与 KL 掩码之间，而不只是稠密训练与稀疏训练之间。接着比较表 1 至表 3，因为它们显示不同配置分别在对话、推理和摘要中领先。严格复现应记录掩码共享方式、初始化、beta、掩码权重正则化、参考激活或掩码头结构，以及训练后的掩码分布；没有这些记录，“稀疏偏好优化”的主张就过于缺乏细节，难以比较。
